chapters.title: Chapter 351: Ask the heart stone!
paragraphs: This is a portable transmission device, but it is disposable.
"With this disk alone, it is impossible to reach the Canglan Continent directly."
Su Lang pondered silently, "It should first teleport us to the place where the time-space crack is, and then go to Canglan Continent through the time-space crack.
It's not wrong to think about it, time and space are related to the human retreat, so important, of course, you must be careful! "
At this time, Wu Junai poured spiritual power into the disc, and the big disc on the table flew into the sky, instantly expanding, covering a radius of tens of meters.
Immediately afterwards, a large amount of light burst out from the disk.
The moment Su Lang was shrouded in light, he felt waves in the surrounding space.
After a lot of spins and turns, when his vision was restored, he had already turned into a vast underground world.
At the same time, in the canyon, the disc that burst out with a huge amount of light was also shattered and disappeared.
"Is this the place where the space-time crack lies?"
"It looks so empty, there seems to be nothing!"
"No, no, your eyes are blinded. There are formations everywhere here, but they are just being covered up."
"Xuedi Lin is right. The surroundings are densely packed with powerful formations."
Everyone had a conversation, and finally a group of Jinmen disciples discovered the strangeness.
After learning that there were dangerous formations around, everyone became more careful.
Su Lang looked around curiously, but found nothing.
"If I activate the one-key array formation, according to the urine nature of the system, there must be a function of'array recognition'.
If I have this ability at this time, the surrounding stitches will be able to show the slightest. "
Thinking of this, Su Lang ticked the corner of his mouth, and raised a strong expectation for the one-key training that was about to open.
"Follow me!"
Wrinkle Junai is so used to everyone's reactions, he faintly dropped a sentence, and walked forward.
Li Qiming immediately followed, Jin Xiutian and others followed close behind. Su Lang and Xiao Ning looked at each other and walked in the end.
After walking forward for less than a minute, everyone came to an empty room.
"God, the formation here is stronger!"
"I can feel that if all the formations here are activated, even the arrival of the Valkyrie can stop a moment!"
"Look, the stone in the middle is the legendary questioning stone!"
"Before going to the time and space cracks, we must go through the test of the heart stone, so as not to be mixed with insiders and destroy our time and space cracks!"
"Hehe, if Wenxinshi detects a gangster, I am afraid that countless formations will come and wipe it out immediately!"
Everyone talked and gave pointers.
"Ask the heart stone?"
Su Lang's eyes flashed, and he immediately understood the characteristics of the heart-enquiring stone.
"It turned out to be a god-level treasure!
"The role is worthy of the name, Wenxin! Even if you rely on means to cover up your thoughts, you can never hide the test of the stone."
Su Lang nodded slowly, "This is a very good baby."
"According to the regulations, everyone has to experience the questioning stone before they can go through the cracks in time and space."
At this time, Wu Junai said, "Now, Li Qiming, you are the first to come."
As the number one student of the Warmen, Li Qiming was deeply respected by Jun Ai.
"Yes! Mentor!"
Li Qiming bowed his hands and came to the questioning stone.
The next moment, a burst of light burst out from the heart-enquiring stone, drowning Li Qiming's figure.
In less than three seconds, the light gradually dissipated, and Li Qiming retreated to the side if nothing had happened.
Obviously, Li Qiming is not a traitor to the Fengling clan, and does not have any evil intentions towards the human clan.
"Next, Jin Xiutian."
Wrinkle Junai waved his hand, and Jin Xiutian also bowed his hand to check.
The light burst, and then dissipated, Jin Xiutian also stood aside safe and sound.
Obviously, he has no problem.
"next."

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Arrived in Canglan Continent!
paragraphs: "it is good."
Su Lang arched his hands and came to Wen Xin Shi.
Who is honest, he was a little nervous, because he didn't know if the questioning heart stone would let him expose the existence of the system.
"The system is extremely mysterious, but it is unreasonable. This questioning heart stone should not be able to detect it."
"Furthermore, Wenxinshi is testing whether the student is a Fengling clan traitor. The testing mechanism should not involve other aspects."
Just thinking of this, there was a burst of light on the Wenxin Stone.
At this moment, Su Lang felt that this light turned out to be a special ‘mental attack’.
The instinctive resistance of Su Lang's mental power was directly penetrated by the light.
"It is indeed magical, the mental power of the sea of mind cannot be resisted!"
"And this feeling...It is estimated that even if the Valkyrie comes, he can't resist."
"What a magical treasure!"
As Su Lang thought, the light gradually dissipated.
He didn't feel any danger from beginning to end, and he didn't know how Wen Xinshi tested it.
"next..."
Wu Junai nodded, and the next student walked up while waving, Su Lang stepped aside.
Next, a group of students stepped forward to test, and the final result was that everyone had no problems.
"well."
"Next, I will take you to the crack in time and space!"
Xu Junai finally showed a smile, he walked forward with his hands on his back, and all the students followed.
This time, after going forward for half an hour, Wrinkle Junai stopped.
Here is a very long corridor, the front is pitch black, and you can't see your fingers.
Su Lang looked at the front, vaguely feeling a slight spatial fluctuation in front of him.
Ahead is a crack in time and space!
"The time and space cracks are not stable, the formation must be opened for stability, and only one teleport can be carried out in a short time."
"If someone doesn't listen to the order and it can't be transmitted, don't blame me."
"Now everyone is around me and follow me seven steps forward!"
As soon as Wu Junai's voice fell, everyone immediately surrounded him, for fear of taking a step behind.
Soon, everyone surrounded Ruan Jun'ai with no flow.
"first step!"
Wrinkle Junai stepped forward, and everyone followed.
In an instant, the endless array of rays of light lit up around, and the dark corridor was illuminated by the light, and an abrupt gray vortex emerged.
This vortex is like being in the air with poor PS technology P, incompatible with the surrounding environment.
"The second step!"
Ruan Junai's voice came again, and everyone took another step, and the surrounding formation burst into a stronger light.
Next, under the leadership of Wu Junai, Su Lang and others took seven steps.
After the last step was taken, the light of the formation suddenly disappeared, and everyone felt black in front of them, and a squeezing force fell on them.
This squeezing force is so strong that it can only be barely resisted by a military commander.
However, everyone present is above Wu Wang, and Su Lang's true strength is even the pinnacle of Wu Huang. Of course, this pressure is not in his eyes.
The force of squeezing came for a moment, and Su Lang suddenly felt that his senses began to twist.
Vision, hearing, and even the perception of time and space have become extremely unstable.
"Is this what it feels like to travel through time and space?"
Su Lang took a deep breath, held his breath, and stopped worrying about the outside world.
Under the situation of time perception confusion, and I don't know how long it has passed before Su Lang felt that his surroundings had returned to normal.
Immediately afterwards, a strong aura rushed towards his face, making people feel like lying in hot spring water.
"Oh wow, is this the Canglan Continent? What a strong aura!"
"Yes, the aura here is almost comparable to the best aura training room in our school."
"The spirit is strong, there must be many treasures, this Canglan Continent is simply fat and oily!"
Everyone was absorbing aura in intoxication, and their faces were full of surprises.
At the same time, Li Qiming, Jin Xiutian, Sun Teng and others looked at Su Lang with a sneer.
In their opinion, Su Lang is only a military commander, and it will definitely be difficult to pass through the cracks in time and space.
However, when they saw Su Lang, they immediately became shocked and surprised.
I saw that Su Lang was alive and well, his eyes glowing watching the surroundings, his energy was even better than both of them!

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Tatian stronghold!
paragraphs: "I'm going! How is this possible?"
"It's not a joke to travel through the cracks of time and space, he is not a martial-arts-level shit?
"Mad, what a wicked one!"
The students who looked at Su Lang were unbelievable.
At this time, Su Lang was in a very good mood.
Finally arrived in Canglan Continent!
For others, Canglan Continent has many treasures, fat and oily, but they can only look at it from a distance.
But it's different for him!
With clone dispatch and one-click treasure hunting, he can madly grab the resources of Canglan Continent while lying down and sleeping.
However, it is not yet possible to dispatch the treasure hunt flying flying gliders until the outside world.
Suppressing the surprise in his heart, Su Lang began to observe the surrounding environment.
Here is also an empty underground space, surrounded by gray and powerful formations.
Moreover, there was even a mysterious cloud of pure moon fire on the gray wall!
"I didn't expect to see Xuanyun Jingyuehuo here!"
Su Lang looked surprised, "Yes, time and space cracks are so important, and it must be foolproof. It is appropriate to cover the breath with Xuanyun Jingyue Fire!
At this moment, Wujun Ai said lightly.
"Now we have reached the Canglan Continent!"
"The territory of the Canglan Continent is almost endless, with tens of thousands of intelligent races living."
"Our human race can be said to be the weakest intelligent race here, so when you act, you must be careful not to expose yourself, let alone provoke foreign races!"
"Now, we will leave here and go to the stronghold established by our human race on the Canglan Continent."
Having said that, Ruo Junai once again threw a disc-shaped teleportation array to activate it.
Su Lang drove up to Wu Junai in his car, and after a while, the picture in front of him changed again.
This is a huge underground space, and Su Lang can't find the end with mental energy.
All sides of this space are wrapped by jade piles, with golden runes engraved on it, and there are a lot of mysterious clouds and pure moon fire lingering endlessly, isolating the breath.
Su Lang could feel that it was a warrior who released Xuanyun Jingyue Fire in secret to keep it alive.
On the ground, there are towers and pavilions built in accordance with the architectural style of the Blue Star, row upon row, endless.
"This is our stronghold!"
Wu Junai showed a hint of excitement, "This is the first step for our human race to set foot on the Canglan Continent!"
"Teacher, I will surely be able to overcome the thorns and thorns, go forward courageously, destroy the Wind Spirit Race, and stand firm in this Canglan continent!"
"Yes! Senior Yanxingxing opened up a stronghold in the Canglan Continent for me, and I will live up to it!"
All the trainees expressed their ambitions with pride.
"well!"
"It is worthwhile for the university to spend so many resources to nurture you! Now, let me introduce our stronghold."
Wu Junai smiled, "This stronghold is called Tatian stronghold, and it is the largest stronghold of our human race on the Canglan Continent.
The stronghold is composed of martial arts and rising stars of the various human races. Counting your group, there are already more than 1,000 people in the stronghold..."
Listening to Wu Junai's words, Su Lang pondered silently: "It seems that Human Race has more than one stronghold in Canglan Continent.
Also, Anxin instructor said before that Xuanyuan Academy sends elite disciples to Canglan Continent every year.
Although certainly not all such talents as Hall of Fame students, they are definitely not bad.
From the time the cracks were discovered to today, the days have been accumulated, and I don't know how much power has been accumulated here. "
As Su Lang thought about it, Ruan Junai also introduced the entire base.

This Tatian stronghold has thousands of people, including dozens of Wu Zun people. In addition to Tatian Hall, Spirit Gathering God Pool, Preaching Hall, Experience Tower, Spirit Beast Garden and other buildings.
Tatian Temple is the core of Tatian stronghold, responsible for handling all kinds of matters, from high-level decision-making to penalty rewards, etc., all under the control of Tatian Temple.
The Spirit Gathering Sacred Pool is to gather the surrounding auras in an array to form a liquid aura with a concentration beyond imagination for everyone to practice without any restrictions.
In the preaching hall, there are strong human races to teach the practice experience day and night, and all disciples can go in and listen at any time, without restrictions.
The experience tower is used to screen human elites, rank them, and give them the qualifications to go out for experience.
Spirit Beast Garden, as the name suggests, is a place dedicated to raising spirit beasts!

chapters.title: Chapter 354: I want to vomit blood with envy
paragraphs: On the Blue Star, the fierce beast cannot be subdued by the human race anyway.
Because those fierce beasts are all under the command of the Wind Spirit Race.
They have long been imposed by the Fengling tribe, and it is difficult to destroy them, and they have been secretly controlled by the Fengling tribe for generations!
But the Fengling clan control is only a small part of the fierce beasts in their territory.
With so many spirit beasts in the Canglan Continent, how can the mere Wind Spirit Race completely control it?
Therefore, when arriving on the Canglan Continent, the human race can select spirit beasts, subdue them, and become a great help for themselves.
However, in order to prevent the fact that the human race had a stronghold in the Canglan Continent from being exposed, the spirit beasts that people conquered have never brought back Blue Star.
And those spirit beasts who were subdued by the human race were all raised in the spirit beast garden.
"Spirit beast!"
"If it is possible, I would rather accept one as a mount."
"It's just that to become my mount, you must have great potential, otherwise you won't be able to keep up with me within a few days after taking over."
Everyone has a dream of riding a mount, and Su Lang is no exception.
When he thought of riding a tall and mighty spirit beast to hire the world, Su Lang raised his mouth, revealing a touch of expectation.
However, compared to the spirit beast, Su Lang was more looking forward to going out for experience.
As long as he goes out, his clone and the treasure hunting flying flying flying flying can be dispatched to grab a lot of wealth!

According to Rue Junai, the entire Tatian stronghold is a closed space. If you want to go out, you must obtain the qualification to go out and leave the Tatian stronghold through the teleportation formation.
There are two conditions for qualifying.
First, experience the tower.
The training tower is divided into fifteen layers, each layer is guarded by masters.
You must break through the nine floors to get the qualifications for going out.
Second, the means of concealment.
In order to prevent the existence of the human race from being known by the aliens, everyone who goes out for experience must have strong enough concealment methods.
If the concealment method fails the assessment, then even if the combat power reaches the standard, it will not be possible to go out for experience.
"Hidden means, I have Xuanyun Jingyuehuo, it's totally fine."
"In terms of combat power, with my seemingly military commander-level combat power, I definitely cannot pass the ninth floor."
Su Lang touched his chin and thought to himself, "It seems that only some strength can be exposed."
At this time.
"Everyone also understands this Tatian stronghold."
"Now, I will take you to the Temple of Heaven to register and make a register, and set up a life card!"
Wu Junai waved his hand and flew towards the middle of the Tatian stronghold.
The others hurriedly rose into the air, followed by Wu Jun Ai.
Everyone was flying, and some people looked at Su Lang subconsciously.
Su Lang is only a military commander and does not have the instinct to fly. If there is no one to help, he will make a fool of himself!
However, what happened the next moment made them want to vomit blood with envy.
Xiao Ning's complexion was reddish, she wrapped Su Lang's waist with her slender jade arms, took Su Lang to the sky, and followed closely.
"This is so special, it's already a hug!"
"Xiao Ning is actually willing to hug Su Lang, is their relationship so close?"
"My Tianle, originally I still had a glimmer of hope in my heart, but now it seems that Xiao Ning is really getting along with Su Lang!"
"Hey hey..."
In the envy and jealousy of all the students, Tatian Temple quickly appeared in front of them.
This is a white hall with a large area, magnificent and shocking.
Outside the main hall is a huge square with many people coming and going.
Each of them has a majestic aura, a high level of cultivation, and the last time they are at the level of King Wu.
At this time, Su Lang and others followed Wu Junai to the ground, and immediately attracted the attention of many warriors.
"This is the genius who came from Blue Star this year!"
"It is said that this group are all Hall of Fame students. I think I couldn't climb up to Zijin students back then."
"These are the real geniuses. They will definitely develop faster here, maybe Wu Zun will appear soon!"
"Are you blind? Look, the student behind Teacher Wu is already a junior martial artist!"
"That one is also the quasi-wuzun, and there are several peak martial emperors!"
"Fuck, this batch of Hall of Fame students is stronger than the previous batch, it's just a bunch of evildoers."
"Hey, look, how can there be a Martial Commander there?"

"It's just that to become my mount, you must have great potential, otherwise you won't be able to keep up with me within a few days after taking over."
Everyone has a dream of riding a mount, and Su Lang is no exception.
When he thought of riding a tall and mighty spirit beast to hire the world, Su Lang raised his mouth, revealing a touch of expectation.
However, compared to the spirit beast, Su Lang was more looking forward to going out for experience.
As long as he goes out, his clone and the treasure hunting flying flying flying flying can be dispatched to grab a lot of wealth!
According to Rue Junai, the entire Tatian stronghold is a closed space.
If you want to go out, you must obtain the qualification to go out and leave the Tatian stronghold through the teleportation formation.
There are two conditions for qualifying.
First, experience the tower.
The training tower is divided into fifteen layers, each layer is guarded by masters.
You must break through the nine floors to get the qualifications for going out.
Second, the means of concealment.
In order to prevent the existence of the human race from being known by the aliens, everyone who goes out for experience must have strong enough concealment methods.
If the concealment method fails the assessment, then even if the combat power reaches the standard, it will not be possible to go out for experience.
"Hidden means, I have Xuanyun Jingyuehuo, it's totally fine."
"In terms of combat power, with my seemingly military commander-level combat power, I definitely cannot pass the ninth floor."
Su Lang touched his chin and thought to himself, "It seems that only some strength can be exposed."
At this time.
"Everyone also understands this Tatian stronghold."
"Now, I will take you to the Temple of Heaven to register and make a register, and set up a life card!"
Wu Junai waved his hand and flew towards the middle of the Tatian stronghold.
The others hurriedly rose into the air, followed by Wu Jun Ai.
Everyone was flying, and some people looked at Su Lang subconsciously.
Su Lang is only a military commander and does not have the instinct to fly.
If there is no one to help, he will make a fool of himself!
However, what happened the next moment made them want to vomit blood with envy.
Xiao Ning's complexion was reddish, she wrapped Su Lang's waist with her slender jade arms, took Su Lang to the sky, and followed closely.
"This is so special, it's already a hug!"
"Xiao Ning is actually willing to hug Su Lang, is their relationship so close?"
"My Tianle, originally I still had a glimmer of hope in my heart, but now it seems that Xiao Ning is really getting along with Su Lang!"
"Hey hey..."
In the envy and jealousy of all the students, Tatian Temple quickly appeared in front of them.
This is a white hall with a large area, magnificent and shocking.
Outside the main hall is a huge square with many people coming and going.
Each of them has a majestic aura, a high level of cultivation, and the last time they are at the level of King Wu.
At this time, Su Lang and others followed Wu Junai to the ground, and immediately attracted the attention of many warriors.
"This is the genius who came from Blue Star this year!"
"It is said that this group are all Hall of Fame students.
I think I couldn't climb up to Zijin students back then."
"These are the real geniuses.
They will definitely develop faster here, maybe Wu Zun will appear soon!"
"Are you blind?
Look, the student behind Teacher Wu is already a junior martial artist!"
"That one is also the quasi-wuzun, and there are several peak martial emperors!"
"Fuck, this batch of Hall of Fame students is stronger than the previous batch, it's just a bunch of evildoers."
"Hey, look, how can there be a Martial Commander there?"

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Set up the life card!
paragraphs: "Huh? Martial-arts class? Are you dazzled?"
"No, there is indeed a Martial Commander-level, you see, it is him!"
Everyone looked for it, and their eyes gradually converged on Su Lang.
"Looking noisy, it's really a military commander!"
"Tsk tusk, I don't know what the academy is up to, even the Martial Commander-level has been put in!"
"That is, what is the use of a military commander here? I'm afraid I won't understand anything if I go to the preaching hall to attend a class."

"Not only that, but at the rank of military commander, he can't even pass the first level of the training tower. Could it be that he plans to stay here for more than a hundred years to be promoted to the emperor before going to the training tower?"
"Don't think about it this way, people martial-arts-level can come to Tatian stronghold, there will be specialties, don't just look at the cultivation base."
"It seems to say that, but I don't know what is special about this junior."

"No, no, no, in my opinion, he has reached this level at such a young age, and his talent must be extraordinary. It must be the school's decision to send him to the Tatian stronghold so that he can shorten his growth time."
"Hahaha, shorten the growth time? How much can it be shortened? I'm afraid we won't wait for the battle between our human race and the wind spirit race."
A group of veteran students looked at Su Lang curiously, pointed and talked.
The news spread ten to ten, and soon, the fact that there was a Martial Commander among the new students spread throughout the Tatian stronghold.
He is even more famous than a Wuzun genius like Li Qiming.
On this occasion.
Under the leadership of Wu Junai, Su Lang and others walked into the Temple of Heaven.
The Tatian Temple is divided into many rooms, like departments, responsible for different matters.
Xu Junai led the students all the way to the door of one of the huge rooms.
"Tuk tuk!"
Wu Junai knocked on the door and said, "You Li Daoyou, it's me, this year's new student has arrived."
"Instructor Wrinkle Junai!"
The door opened, and a thin old man walked out of it, arching his hand to Ruan Jun Ai.
The old man looked dry, his hair was yellow and his eyes were blank.
Su Lang glanced, calmly called up the old man's attribute panel, and found that this person was named Li Yuanju, who was an intermediate Wuzun expert.
"All come in!"
Xi Junai waved his hand to Su Lang and the others, then talked with Li Yuanju and walked into the room.
The students followed suit one after another and entered the room.
"This is the place where the students register and set up the life card?"
Su Lang looked around and found that there were many wooden cabinets in the room, like bookcases, with jade plates carved with white jade on them.
Some of these jade plaques are shining and radiant, as if paying attention to the aura of life, while others are extremely dim, like a dead object.
"This is the fate card, this is the first time I have seen you!"
Xiao Ning also looked at the surrounding wooden cabinets curiously, "It is said that the life card is used to determine whether the students who went out to practice are dead.
It can interact with its owner, and if the owner dies, the jade card will lose its light.
Moreover, the life card can also judge the distance of the owner from this place, the farther away, the dimmer the light, but it will not go out. "
"Hmm.
Su Lang nodded and said, "It can be considered a strange treasure."
Through the ability of'weapon recognition', he has already thoroughly looked at the bottom of these life cards, but there is no way to secretly control people.
At this time, Xi Junai and Li Yuanju talked a few words, and then began to make life cards for the students.
The first one to go up was still Li Qiming.
"Ancestor, junior Li Qiming!"
Li Qiming stepped forward to bow and salute Li Yuanju.
When everyone heard what he called Li Yuanju, they were surprised that Li Yuanju and Li Qiming were actually a family!
In this way, Li Yuanju is also a member of the Li family of the ancient family of hermits!
"It's worthy of being a hidden ancient clan, a master like a cloud!"
This idea flashed through everyone's mind at the same time.
"Li Qiming, you are very good!"
Li Yuanju nodded with a smile, obviously satisfied with the younger generation of this family.
Immediately, Li Yuanju made a register for Li Qiming and made a fate card.
The material is very simple, just a piece of obedient jade, Li Qiming's blood, and a trace of spiritual power.
After special refining, a shining life card appeared.
Because Li Qiming is very close to the Ming brand, this jade brand is super bright, almost comparable to a led bulb.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: It's time to hang up
paragraphs: "Next! Jin Xiutian!"
Wu Junai waved his hand to let Jin Xiu go forward.
Immediately, they were making life cards one by one, and dozens of life cards were quickly added to the surrounding wooden cabinets.
"Thank you."
Wrinkle Junai bowed his hand to Li Yuanju and led the students around and left.
Not long after, everyone came outside the hall again.
"I'll take you here."
"From now on, you will develop freely."
"I just briefly introduced the Tatian stronghold before, and more detailed information is recorded in it, and the rules must be memorized."
Wrinkle Junai said as he took out a pile of jade slips from the space ring and distributed them to everyone.
After dividing the jade slips, he quickly left and entered the Temple of Tatian again.
Obviously, Wu Jun Ai is busy with something.
Indeed, he only saw him traveling between Blue Star and Canglan Continent, and at least part of the communication between the two sides had to fall on him.
On the square, all the students scattered with jade slips.
"Senior Su Lang, where are you going now?"
The light of Xiao Ning's beautiful eyes flowed and fell on Su Lang.
"I plan to find a place to live first."
Su Lang threw the jade slip in his hand, "It is recorded that every student can choose an independent residence, just like in Tianshenggu.
Xiao Ning smiled and said, "Well, then I will go with you!"
"Okay."
Su Lang did not refuse, and the beauty is accompanied, even if there is no other idea, seductive is good!
The two walked together, but no one came to find fault on the way.
After all, this is a stronghold in Tatian, but the hope of the human race. Who dares to kill each other here?
Even if you have a grudge, you must find a no man's land far away from Tatian stronghold!
At this time, Li Qiming was a little sad: "This Su Lang is a military commander. He wants to rise to the level where he can go out and practice. He doesn't know how many years it will take.
It is Xiao Ning's woman. She is already a senior martial emperor. She will definitely go out to practice as soon as possible. I want to find a chance to avenge her! "
Thinking of this, Li Qiming's eyes were a bit murderous.
At this time, Su Lang and Xiao Ning came to the residential area.
There are a number of unique two-story small buildings built here, and each small building has a defensive barrier and a mental perception barrier.
The method of choosing a place to live is exactly the same as that of Tianshenggu. Small buildings with no one can directly occupy them and turn them into their own use.
Su Lang and Xiao Ning chose two adjacent small buildings, and after saying goodbye, they separated and went home.
Su Lang entered the small building, looked around, and found that the room was empty, apparently no one had ever lived.
"Very well, I don't want to live in a second-hand house.
Su Lang showed a satisfied smile, and immediately made some arrangements according to his own preferences.
In a short while, the small building will be properly arranged.
Su Lang sat on the bed, silently thinking about the next plan.
"The most urgent thing is to go out to practice, send out the clone and the treasure hunt flying flying gliders!"
"Although it is said that my martial-arts-level combat power will surely shock everyone and make it suspect that I have a secret.
However, even counting the trump card of Swallowing Clone, Wuzun-level Xiao Xiaozhi didn't take it seriously. The entire Tatian stronghold could fight me, not many!
What's more, the Tatian stronghold is the place where the human race hopes to gather, and they basically work together, and there is almost no reason to build a big wind.
On the contrary, the more genius I behave, the more resources I get, and it's time to open up and hang up! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang couldn't help but tick the corner of his mouth, revealing a touch of excitement.
Do what you think.
Su Lang did not notify Xiao Ning, but went out alone, following the route marked in the jade slip towards the tower of experience.
Go all the way, passing the preaching hall and the spiritual gathering pool.
In the preaching hall, from time to time there are explanations of certain exercises by the old strong people, and the sound is heard, and it is inspiring.
In the Spirit Gathering Pool, hundreds of powerful men above Wuwang level floated in the air, devouring spiritual energy to strengthen themselves.
When Su Lang passed by the Preaching Hall, the warriors inside were listening carefully, and did not notice him.
But when he passed the Spirit Gathering Sacred Pool, it attracted the attention of many people.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: In the blink of an eye
paragraphs: "Is this the legendary martial-arts-level genius?"
"Based on my many years of experience, I can tell that this person will not exceed twenty years old. He is really awesome when he reaches an intermediate military commander at such an age!"
"Yes, when I was 27 years old, I only broke through to the intermediate military commander, and it took me 18 years to break through to the senior military commander!"

"It's a pity that even if he has a different appearance and is stronger than me, it will take at least a hundred years to reach the Martial Emperor rank. I am afraid that he will not be able to keep up with the final battle."
Everyone was cultivating while whispering.
At this moment, someone suddenly said in surprise: "Huh? Look, he has gone far, he didn't even enter the Spirit Gathering God Pool to cultivate!"
"what!?"
"Really, he left directly!"
"Look at the route and direction he walks, this is going to... the tower of experience!"
"No! No matter how talented he is, he is only a martial-arts-level, such a weak combat power, to break the tower of experience!?"
"Could it be that he is used to being arrogant and arrogant on the Blue Star, and he doesn't care about anything, thinking he is invincible in the world?"
"Let's go noisy, let me see if this kid is really going to experience the tower!"
"Wait, I will go too!"
There was a commotion in the Spirit Gathering Sacred Pool, and finally one by one left the Spirit Gathering Sacred Pool in surprise, following Su Lang far behind.
In a short period of time, almost all the warriors in the Spirit Gathering God Pool followed curiously.
"Huh? So many people follow me?
Although Su Lang was a martial artist, his true combat power had reached the peak of the Martial Emperor, and he immediately noticed the martial artists who had followed him in the distance.
However, he did not care about those warriors, but walked forward on his own.
Soon, a huge white jade tower appeared in front of him.

This white jade pagoda has fifteen floors, and each floor is 100 meters high. The entire tower is extremely tall, almost like a mountain. In the enclosed space of the Tatian stronghold, it is like a heavenly pillar of Buzhou Mountain!
"Is this the training tower? I don't know how the levels are set up."
Su Lang ticked the corner of his mouth and slowly walked into the gate of the experience tower.
His move immediately stunned the students who followed.
"Fuck! This kid actually entered the training tower! I thought he was just here to visit!"
"Tian Le, I really don't know how high the sky is, and the military commander-level only dare to break into the experience tower!"
"The first level of the experience tower requires a junior martial king to get through. This kid is really arrogant."
"In my opinion, he will soon run out dingy!"
"It's not bad to learn a lesson here, so that it won't suffer a bigger loss later."
The students talked a lot, and couldn't help but sneer at Su Lang's behavior.
On this occasion, Su Lang had entered the training tower, as if he had come to a new world.
The first floor of the Pagoda is one hundred meters high and one thousand meters long and wide. It is cast from white jade on all sides and engraved with countless formations.
In the empty space, strands of impermanent white mist drifted, creating a deeper and more secluded environment.
"Huh? How on earth is it?"
Su Lang frowned slightly, and looked around suspiciously.
At this moment, the bursts of light on the four walls and ceiling suddenly shined.
Immediately afterwards, the rays of light condensed into a dazzling figure, holding an imaginary long knife, falling from the sky and killing Su Lang!
"It turned out to be tested by formation!"
"I want to come, everyone has to practice, whoever has time to stay here waiting for someone to challenge.
Guarding with spirit beasts doesn’t work. What should I do if I get injured? Who doesn’t care about my spirit beast..."

Su Lang, who was in a daze, raised his right hand, and with a flick of his finger, the endless green lotus dragon pattern fire condensed into a giant fire dragon, swallowing the bright figure in one mouthful.
The dazzling figure was directly wiped out, without any resistance!
"Om!"
There was a buzzing sound from the first floor of the entire training tower, and the surrounding formation burst out again, condensing into an illusory teleportation formation.
"It's through the first floor, it's really easy!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, walked into the teleportation formation, and immediately disappeared in place.

Outside the training tower, the trainees were waiting for Su Lang to escape griefly with his tail between them, and then surrounded him, telling him the truth about the truth that there are outsiders and outsiders.
But at this time, the first floor of the experience tower suddenly lit up with a humming sound!
Everyone was shocked instantly!

chapters.title: Chapter 359: This son Valkyrie is expected!
paragraphs: In a short period of time, news spread throughout Tatian stronghold like a tornado.

However, the students who came out of the news vowed to promise, and even swear to heaven.
As a result, many students gradually believed.
They immediately put aside the things in their hands and rushed to the training tower with a sense of uncertainty.
When they rushed to the training tower, they saw dozens of students looking up at the training tower, staring dumbfounded and eyes bursting.
"Hey, what is going on!?"
A new student asked strangely: "Why are you all like idiots?"
However, no one paid attention to him, and those sluggish students still looked at the training tower blankly.
"What the is going on?"
The new students were dumbfounded.
At this time, a sluggish student whispered: "The sixth floor, I actually passed the sixth floor, God, is there such a monster in the world?"
His murmur fell into the ears of the newcomers, and it was tantamount to an earth-shattering thunder!
"what did you say!?"
A student squeezed the shoulders of the whisperer and asked in disbelief, "That martial-arts-level kid actually made it through the sixth floor!?"
As soon as this question came out, all the newly arrived students immediately pricked their ears and stared at this side.
"Yes, sixth floor... sixth floor."
The whisperer stared and said with a trembling voice, "It took him a minute to rush through!"
"How is it possible! The opponent on the sixth level is the Martial Emperor! Even if it is only a junior Martial Emperor, it is definitely not a Martial Commander-level can kill!"
"Slaying opponents in the Martial Emperor Realm with the Martial Commander realm, crossing two realms, is this in a dream state?"
"What the is going on, is that kid hiding his strength? Impossible, I can't be mistaken, he is a military commander."
The new students looked at each other, with stormy seas in their hearts and disbelief on their faces.
At this moment, the seventh floor of the Experience Tower suddenly buzzed!
"Passed the seventh floor!!"
Whether it was the first batch of students who followed Su Lang, or those who were called from behind, they all fell into a sluggishness.
At the scene, Wan Lai was silent, and the needle drop was audible!
At the same time, in the Temple of Treading Heaven, a group of elders were staring in the direction of the Tower of Experience with their mouths stunned.
All of these elders are martial arts, and even the quasi-martial gods, every one of them was once a prestigious powerhouse!
Long Sheng ordered them to have no waves, but at this time, why are there no waves? It was a terrifying tsunami!

"This son, able to kill the junior martial emperor with the martial commander realm, is really the first enchantment of our human race since the ages, and it is not worse than those genius disciples of the holy race and immortal race!"
"Too enchanting, too defying, this martial is hopeful! We must protect it!
"It's a pity, it's a pity that he was born so late so many years, otherwise our human race would be more than Master Yanxingxing a Valkyrie!"
"In any case, we must try our best to train him. I would like to accept him as a disciple and teach him what I have learned throughout my life!"
"You are so shameless, even you want to accept such a wicked character as a disciple? Only I am qualified to be his master!"
"Get out of here! You old stubborn group have already fallen behind, I'll teach you now!"
"What old stubbornness? You owe you to clean up, are you? I don't know how many good things the old man has, can you match it?"
"Hehe, what's good about your broken stuff, oops, dissatisfied, come and fight!"
"Don't quarrel, this son has amazing talents and aptitude, we can teach together!"
"This is reasonable, let's go over quickly, this child has passed the seventh floor and should be coming out soon."
The elders of the martial arts class had a quarrel, blushing and almost fighting.
Fortunately, in the end, a compromise was figured out to avoid a fight.
Immediately, the elders of all the martial arts were ready to leave the Tatian Temple and personally go to the experience tower to pick up Su Lang.
But at this moment.
The eighth floor of the training tower emits light again, and there is a buzzing sound! !

"I'm going, why are so many people?"

Su Lang looked at the thousands of people below, with surprise on his face, "Could it be that the experience tower engages in activities, and it won't be possible to get through one floor and send another one?"
However, when he saw that everyone looked horrified, he quickly reacted.
"It seems that my record of breaking the tower will be revealed in some form, so that everyone is shocked!"
Su Lang looked around the crowd and found the place where the group of Wuzun-level existences gathered.
Immediately afterwards, he flew down from the sky with a long sword, and fell in front of a group of elders.
His every move drew everyone's attention.
"Seniors, junior Su Lang!"
Su Lang raised his hand to the elders, courteous.
The elders of all martial arts used various methods to confirm Su Lang's cultivation level in an instant, and found that he was not covering up his cultivation level, and he was shocked and relieved.
"Little friend Su Lang, quickly waive the gift!"
"Little friend Su Lang, come over, and I will show you palmistry."
"I am one of the deacon elders of the Temple of Heaven, Su Lang, would you like to be my disciple?"
"Little friend Su Lang, I immediately reached the Quasi-God level.
I have lived for a thousand or two hundred years.
Are you willing to be my heir?"
The elders rolled their eyes and started to accept disciples one after another.
Obviously, even though they had previously said to teach Su Lang together, they still wanted to give it a try to see if they could "sweep" Su Lang, a super genius.
If they can become Su Lang's only master, then when Su Lang will become a Martial God or even a higher realm in the future, they will be touched.
And the behavior of these respectable elders personally inviting Su Lang by their mouths immediately made the rest of the students envied.
You know, although you can get the best training resources in Tatian stronghold, you can still go to the mission hall to attend lectures.
But how can this compare to the teaching by a master who has lived for thousands of years?

chapters.title: Chapter 362: We can teach you together
paragraphs: "I really envy Su Lang, so many senior Wu Zun are willing to accept him as a disciple..."
"Who makes Su Lang so against the sky? He is not a genius at the same level as us, incomparable."
Hundreds of warriors talked in low voices, showing envy.
At this time, Su Lang smiled faintly, and said, "Sorry, seniors, juniors don't want to be a teacher for the time being."
As soon as this remark came out, the audience instantly quieted down!
Refused!
Su Lang tactfully declined all Wu Zun's invitations to accept disciples!
Almost all the students were unbelievable.
That was an invitation to accept an apprentice from the elder Wu Zun expert, Su Lang actually refused it all!
You know, there is a gap between the new generation of Wu Zun and the old generation of Wu Zun, and it is still very big!
Just practice the exercises, the older generation of Wu Zun has thousands of years of experience, let alone dabble in other aspects.
There was an older generation of Wu Zun who taught that it was like standing on the shoulders of giants.
However, Su Lang refused!
In addition to those students, the Wu Zun who sent the invitation were also shocked.
They thought that Su Lang would think about it, but who knew that Su Lang refused without even thinking about it?
The scene was quiet for a while, and all the martial arts looked at each other before walking out of an old man with a white beard.
As soon as the old man with white beard walked out, he attracted everyone's attention, because he is the strongest warrior in Tatian stronghold at present-Zhushen Lubai!
"What will Senior Lu Bai do?
"Will Su Lang anger the seniors by not giving face so much?"
"Seniors won't be so narrow-minded, maybe there are other things to explain?"
The students whispered to each other, and they showed their doubts.
At this time, Lu Bai spoke up.
"Little friend Su Lang, old man Lu Bai."
"Since you don't want to worship me and wait for anyone to be a teacher, then we will teach you together, okay?"
Wow! !
Lu Bai's words directly turned the audience into a boiling pot!
"Oh my God! Not only are the seniors not angry, but they want to teach Su Lang together!"
"What kind of treatment is this? I'm thankful when I can be accepted as a disciple by one of the seniors. Su Lang can actually be taught by all the seniors!!"
"Perhaps in the eyes of your seniors, Su Lang is a stunning piece of jade. Only by working together can he achieve the highest level of achievement!"
"Su Lang, this person is really against the sky!"
People were talking buzzingly, and Lu Bai and senior Wu Zun waited for Su Lang quietly.
However, on the surface they seemed to be waiting, but secretly they had already made up their minds that no matter what Su Lang chose, they would ‘grab’ him and sculpt him well.
At this moment, Su Lang thought for a moment, then smiled and nodded: "It is something Su Lang can't ask for to be taught by the seniors!"
As soon as this statement came out, the students suddenly
——It turns out that Su Lang had this idea. He was not satisfied with being a master at first!
This is a misunderstanding.
Su Lang did not want to worship anyone as a teacher at first.
But he suddenly wanted to use the hands of these veterans to cover up his system functions.
Everything is like worshipping Anxin as a teacher at Xuanyuan Academy.
After all, his one-key refining device can't reach the advanced level for no reason, not to mention the unknown powerful functions such as the one-key refining array behind.
At just this moment, Lu Bai, Zhun Shen, proposed to teach Su Lang with the senior Wu Zun, and he agreed.
With the teachings of these senior Wu Zun, although the things he showed with system functions are still exaggerated, they can have an explanation.
At this moment.
When the senior Wu Zun saw Su Lang agree to come down, they all smiled.
"Okay, everyone go away!"
Lu Bai waved his hand at the students, then turned to Su Lang and said, "Su Lang, come with us!"
"Okay, Master Lu Bai."
Su Lang smiled and nodded.
Immediately, Lu Bai and other Wu Zun seniors soared into the sky and flew towards the Temple of Heaven.
Su Lang also stepped on the long sword, following closely behind.
The students who had dispersed looked at Su Lang's back and couldn't help but sigh with emotion, then turned their heads and left again.
Not long after, all the students on the square had left, and only one person remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 363: This is too scary
paragraphs: This person is Li Qiming!
"Damn Su Lang, you can get the affair of Lu Bai and other seniors, let them teach together!"
Li Qiming narrowed his eyes, his eyes flashed with cold jealousy and killing intent.

He came to this and Tatian stronghold as the first student of the War Gate and a junior Wu Zun. He originally had the opportunity to be valued by Zhushen Lubai and others, and he personally accepted him as an apprentice.

But at this time, the quasi-shen Lubai and other seniors had already accepted Su Lang as disciples, and would definitely teach Su Lang with all his strength, and would no longer have the heart to accept disciples.
Before, in Li Qiming's heart, Su Lang had a "hate for seizing love with a horizontal knife", but at this time, he had to add a "hate for seizing a teacher".
"I will never just swallow this tone! Su Lang, you wait for me!"
Li Qiming gritted his teeth with anger, then stepped forward and directly entered the training tower.
After a while, bursts of light and buzzing came from the training tower, which once again attracted a lot of students to marvel, but no one came to see it.
The other side.
Lu Bai and others have brought Su Lang to a certain room in the Temple of Heaven.
All the Wuzun seniors took their seats one after another, and Lu Bai also let Su Lang sit down.
There are seven people including Su Lang and Lu Bai.
In other words, there are six masters who taught Su Lang together.
"Su Lang, this is Xingshan, this is Shiqi, and these three are Jiang Wu, Qiu Dong, and Wen Yong!"
Lu Bai introduced the other five people to Su Lang, and Su Lang paid a salute. Those old seniors didn't have any pretensions, they were very peaceful.
At this time.
"Su Lang, I always have a question."
Lu Bai touched his beard and asked kindly, "Why are you so powerful?"
"The juniors are very savvy, and they practice the exercises every day!"
Su Lang smiled and said, "From the time I practiced martial arts, I have practiced hundreds of exercises, and only six of the top exercises have reached the perfect level."
As soon as these words came out, Lu Bai and the six others trembled in an instant!
Hundreds of exercises!
This is too scary!
You know, even if Lu Bai lived for more than a thousand years, he had only practiced 30 exercises.
"Su Lang...you, how did you do it!"
Jiang Wu stunned and exclaimed, "Hundreds of exercises, that's so violent, and you practice so many exercises, won't they conflict with each other?"
"Oops! Let me see if your exercises conflict!"
Lu Bai's expression changed drastically, and he immediately came to Su Lang, grabbed his hand and instilled aura into it.
At the same time, he also used his mental power to drive a certain detection method to observe the movement of Su Lang's exercises.
"Oh my God!!"
After some detection, Lu Bai said in horror, "There are indeed hundreds of exercises, and many of them have conflicting attributes!"
"what!?"
Wen Yongteng stood up at once, with a look of panic, "So many exercises conflict with each other, what can we do?"
Xingshan, Shiqi and other old seniors also stood up anxiously and looked at Su Lang nervously.
"No, it's not right, although the exercises conflict with each other, but..."
Lu Bai's old eyes widened in shock, "But not only did the exercises Su Lang practiced didn't conflict, but they merged together!"
"mix together?"
Qiu Dong asked in disbelief, "How is this possible?"
Xingshan showed a hint of excitement: "Could it be... a special physique that we have never seen before?"
"Only physical fitness can explain this rare phenomenon!"
Lu Bai's eyes glowed, staring at Su Lang closely, "We really found a treasure!"
"Su Lang's special physique is the reason why he can accommodate a hundred exercises."
"And he can successfully practice so many exercises, and his unawareness cannot be ignored!"
"I feel that we can teach Su Lang the skills we are good at, and teach the pill formation and other auxiliary Dao, and cultivate him into an all-rounder!"
Xingshan said with a trembling voice, and the excitement on his face grew thicker.
"Cultivating Su Lang into a versatile? It's a good idea!"
Lu Bai's face rose with a slight movement, "However, I still have to seek Su Lang's opinion."
To be honest, Su Lang's savvy is so against the sky, just practicing the exercises is too wasteful.
The senior martial artists didn't want Su Lang to waste his savvy, and wanted to pass on his skills.
At this time, the six senior Wu Zun stared at Su Lang with scorching eyes, seeing Su Lang involuntarily getting goose bumps.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Fight again!
paragraphs: "Uh, I feel comfortable with the exercises, and I want to learn something else."
Su Lang smiled and agreed directly.
The decision of Lu Bai and others was exactly in his arms.
If Lu Bai and others didn't plan to teach Su Lang alchemy, Su Lang would still find ways to ‘seeking advice’.
After all, his purpose is to cover up unreasonable system functions.
"In that case, that would be great!"
"Now, I'll wait to assign the responsibilities, who should teach what homework, don't get confused!"
"Let’s start with me. I have lived for more than a thousand years. Apart from the realm of cultivation, I dabble on the alchemy path the most!"
Lu Bai said excitedly, "At present, I have come into contact with the edge of the Pill God Realm, so let me teach Su Lang to make alchemy!"
Su Lang nodded secretly when he heard this.
"Then I will teach Su Lang refining!"
Shi Qi smiled and said, "My instrumental attainments have reached the highest level."
"I'm afraid that a master is not enough."
Qiudong shook his head, "Moreover, our refining methods have their own merits. Why not teach Su Lang refining together?"
"Look at how Su Lang decides!" Shi Qi smiled.
Su Lang smiled without hesitation: "Ask the two masters to teach me how to refining tools!"
"It's so good!"
Qiu Dong smiled comfortedly and decided to teach Su Lang everything he had learned.
At this time.
Xingshan opened his mouth and said: "My formation is at the highest level of formation, I will teach Su Lang to refining formation."
"The formation training is here, I have to quickly activate the one-key formation training!"
Su Lang was startled when he heard the words, and secretly said, "Otherwise, I won't understand a single word by then, and my ‘world-defying comprehension’ will be exposed!"
Just as Su Lang was thinking about it, Jiang Wu spoke: "Wen Yong and I are not deeply involved in Dan, Qi, and Formation."
"But I have some experience in practicing exercises, and I can help Su Lang choose better exercises to match, and exert the strongest combat power!"
"Wen Yong is best at mental attacks. The spiritual exercise "One Thought Lunar Eclipse" is obscure and esoteric, and it is more dangerous. It is better to teach it alone!"
Hearing this, Wen Yong couldn't help but nodded: "Then let me teach Su Lang's mental attack and defense."
At this point, the six masters have allocated their own teaching content, and Su Lang also nodded happily.
"Time is money. I'm going to teach Su Lang now. Please go to rest first."
Jiang Wu suddenly looked at Su Lang with a smile, showing a hint of eagerness.
"Huh? Why are you the first to teach Su Lang?"
Lu Bai frowned, "May I be the first to come!"
"No, no, no, it's better for me and Qiudong to come first!"
Shi Qi shook his head and said, "We two will teach together. Su Lang will definitely master the refining tool soon, so let's leave it to you to teach."
"Stop fighting!"
Wen Yong stood up, showing a hint of eagerness, "The "One Thought Lunar Eclipse" I want to teach is the most difficult and takes the most time. Can you let me do it?"
"No way, no way!"
Jiang Wu also stood up and said, "Su Lang is most suitable for practicing the exercises, your alchemy weapons are all sideways, let me come first!"
"Jiang Wu! You look down on our three core pill weapons?"
"You...oh, they all said that my "One Thought Lunar Eclipse" is the most difficult!
The senior martial artists competed in front of Su Lang, spitting wildly, without the temperament of a master at all!
"Why is this fighting again?"
Su Lang's mouth twitched, a little speechless.
Immediately, he coughed slightly, and said, "Masters, I want to travel to the Canglan Continent outside and come back to study!"
"what!?"
Lu Bai and the others stopped arguing instantly and looked at Su Lang vigilantly.
"I said, I want to go outside and practice!"
Su Lang took a deep breath and said seriously.
"Su Lang, don't mess around!"
"Yeah, it's dangerous outside, and Emperor Wu often died unclearly!"
"Going out to experience, the more opportunities are, let's study for a period of time, and then go if we become stronger!"
The masters exchanged their eyes, and immediately began to persuade Su Lang with all their heart.
"Masters, I have made up my mind!"
Su Lang resolutely said, "If I can't go out and travel, my heart can't calm down, and I can't study hard!"
What's the joke, how much benefit can the treasure hunt flying flying flying and clone bring in a day?
If you go out one day late, you will lose one day's income!

chapters.title: Chapter 365: Go out to experience!
paragraphs: "Su Lang, do you really want to go out and practice?"
Lu Bai frowned slightly, he really didn't want Su Lang to venture out.
Su Lang nodded and said, "Yes, Master Lu Bai!"
As soon as this remark came out, Lu Bai, Jiang Wu and others looked at each other, and then sighed in unison.
"Well, since you insist, then go out and see the Canglan Continent."
"However, you must be careful, Canglan Continent is really very dangerous."
Lu Bai nodded helplessly, there was a trace of worry on his and Jiang Wu's faces.
"Masters, disciples know."
"In fact, the Intermediate Martial Sovereign is not my ultimate combat power. I still have cards that are useless."
"My concealment method is also very strong, I have Xuanyun Jingyuehuo, cooperate with other methods, if you want to escape, it is very easy!"
"And I don't want to take risks specifically for excitement, I just look around honestly."
Su Lang grinned, and a cloud of profound clouds and pure moon fire condensed in front of him.
"There is Xuanyun Jingyuehuo? That's not bad, but you have to be careful."
Lu Bai nodded and said, "If we didn't have to guard the Tatian stronghold, we would go with you."
"Yeah, it was hard to find you such a big baby."
Wen Yong smiled and said, "How about we find some students to go out with you?"
"If the disciple needs the protection of others at all times, he will never grow up, and the disciple himself will be careful!"
Of course, Su Lang didn't want others to follow, and his face solemnly handed over to Lu Bai and other Wu Zun, "Masters, it should not be too late, I want to go out now.
"That's good."
Wen Yong agreed with a smile, "I am the most leisurely in the Temple of Heaven, so let me send Su Lang out."
"Well, go early and return early!"
Lu Bai and others nodded one after another.
Immediately, under the leadership of Wen Yong, Su Lang left the Temple of Treading Heaven and came to a gray space.
The gray space was very similar to the exit of the time-space crack that Su Lang had experienced before. It was covered with arrays in all directions, with a huge teleportation array in the middle.
In addition, not far from the teleportation array, there is a heart-asking stone.
At this moment, there is a junior Wu Zun and a dozen quasi Wu Zun secretly guarding.
When the warriors go out, they must go through the investigation of these guards.
But this time it was carried by Wen Yong, a prestigious senior Wu Zun, and naturally no one came to investigate Su Lang.
"Here is the exit for going out."
Wen Yong introduced, "Anyone who goes out must go through the heart-questioning stone, just in case.
In addition, the warriors in the Tatian stronghold must also go through the test of the questioning stone within a certain period of time to prevent people from changing their minds. "
"That's it."
Su Lang nodded suddenly.
Terran has tried so hard to keep the secret of Tatian stronghold.
However, as the only hope and retreat of the human race, no amount of effort can be overstated.
"Well, Su Lang, go to the teleportation formation."
"I will send you to the safest branch location.
Wen Yong said with a smile, "One thing to remember, each time you go out to practice is only one month at most, and after one month, you must come back!"
"The disciple knows."
Su Lang smiled brightly, and immediately stood on the teleportation formation with a trace of expectation.
Seeing this, Wen Yong waved his hands to the guards, and several of them immediately activated the teleportation formation.
The teleportation array hummed slightly, and a distorted light enveloped Su Lang.
In the next moment, Su Lang disappeared in place!
"You must come back safely."
Wen Yong looked at the teleportation array and left immediately.
Several warriors guarding each other looked at each other, their faces a little surprised.
"A Martial Commander can be personally escorted by Senior Wen Yong, this is the zealous Su Lang that was heard before!"
"It must be him. He has passed the ninth floor of the training tower as a military commander. It's a pity that I have a job and I can't get out and watch it."
"A genius like Su Lang will definitely become the mainstay of our human race in the future, and I hope he will have a smooth journey."
The guards of warriors had a conversation.
At this time, another young man walked in outside.
This person is Li Qiming!

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Arrive at the branch office
paragraphs: "Seniors, juniors have to go out to practice." Li Qiming bowed his hands to the void.
"You are... Li Qiming who just passed the training tower, right? You can go out to practice, where are you going?"
The Wu Zun Dao guarding the teleportation formation, they specially guard the teleportation formation, who can go out after passing the experience tower, they will naturally get news the first time.
Therefore, they also know the news that Li Qiming has passed the training tower.
"I don't know, just go to where the previous classmate went."
Li Qiming's face was full of smiles, but there was a trace of murderous intent hidden in his eyes.
"Ok."
Guarding Wu Zun did not know the grievances between Li Qiming and Su Lang, and agreed without hesitation.
Immediately afterwards, Li Qiming stood on the teleportation formation and disappeared after a burst of light.
"Tsk tusk, this batch of newcomers this year is really enchanting!"
"Yes, this junior of the Li family is incredibly powerful. He reached the junior martial arts at a young age and has caught up with me!"

"Haha, the old man doesn't have to worry about it. The younger generation of the Li family grew up in a hidden ancient clan and was born with a golden key. There is no shortage of training resources and famous teachers. There is nothing commendable for this achievement."
"You don't have to say that, the younger generation of the Li family is indeed better than me, a pervert, of course, far worse than this Su Lang."
"Well, Su Lang is not unexpected, at least he can become a Quasi God, the bottleneck of the Valkyrie is not so easy to break."
On this occasion.
In the vast and boundless Canglan Continent, there is a valley shrouded in colorful miasma.
These colorful poisonous miasma are so powerful that they will die if they touch them below the Wuwang level, and they naturally have the ability to isolate mental perception and exploration.
In this valley, there is an underground space hidden.
This is a branch stronghold of Human Race in Canglan Continent.
At this moment, Su Lang had already arrived at this stronghold through the teleportation array. He was walking while observing the surrounding environment.
Very crude!
This is the first impression.
The buildings here are built very randomly, just cubes, and there is no decoration.
Obviously, like the strongholds outside the city on Blue Star, these branch strongholds often face the threat of destruction, so they don't pay attention to appearance.
After walking around the stronghold, Su Lang found that there were fewer than a hundred people here.
The warriors who came and went were all strong men above the Intermediate Martial Emperor, and everyone was full of fierce and outrageous aura.
It can be seen that they often experience battles, and the outside world of Canglan Continent is really dangerous.
At the same time, when Su Lang was observing the others, the others were also looking at him very surprised.
"This guy's aura fluctuates... he is a military commander!?"
"No, how can Martial Commander-level come to Canglan Continent, and how can it pass the Tower of Experience?"
"It should be a special method that simulated the Martial Commander-level aura fluctuations. His true realm must be no weaker than mine."
"His disguise methods are so powerful, my pupil technique that specializes in disguising disguise has no flaws at all!"
"It's very powerful, he is so young, he is comparable to ours!
After some analysis of the martial arts emperor rank martial artists, they were surprised.
"I was originally a military commander, so I don't need to pretend, you can see that there are ghosts in the flaws."
Su Lang rolled his eyes secretly, and then rushed to the place where he applied to go out.
at the same time.
The teleportation array in the branch stronghold lightened slightly, and Li Qiming's figure emerged.
"Here is someone!"
The two Emperor Wu who guarded the teleportation array turned their heads to look at them, and instantly looked in awe!
"It turned out to be a junior Wu Zun!"
"Good face, could it be the newly promoted Wu Zun?"
The two Emperor Wu talked secretly, looking at Li Qiming with envy.
At this time, Li Qiming suddenly bowed his hands to them and smiled: "Two martial emperors, do you know a martial artist-level martial artist? He is my classmate and I am looking for him."
"Martial-arts class?"
"It's the young man disguised as a military commander!"
The two Emperor Wu looked at each other, then pointed in one direction and said: "I've been there, I don't know where I went."

chapters.title: Chapter 367: The sky of Canglan Continent
paragraphs: "Thank you two."
Li Qiming bowed his hands and thanked him, but his figure disappeared.
He started as fast as he could, and wanted to find Su Lang the first time!
The branch base is not large, and with Li Qiming's junior martial arts status, he quickly found the trace of Su Lang.
Su Lang has arrived at the place where he applied to go out.
This is where this branch stronghold communicates with the outside world, and is guarded by two top martial emperors.
Anyone who wants to go out must go through an application.
However, it is just a cutscene.
The way to go out is also very simple, that is, just open a portal to guard the stronghold.
"Two, I want to go out!"
Su Lang smiled at the two guarding emperors, showing white teeth.
"be careful."
"Also, don't bring the trouble back even if you die outside!"
Emperor Wu, who was guarding the passage, looked at Su Lang in surprise, gave a few words, and let him go.
Under the operation of Emperor Wu, the formation gradually opened a small door that could be passed by one person.
"My dears of Canglan Continent, I am here!"
Su Lang's eyes lit up, he took a deep breath, and walked out of the formation with intense excitement.
"Su Lang, your death date is here!
A cruel look rose on Li Qiming's face among the noisy people in the distance.
Soon, he also came to the passage and applied to go out.
The other side.
After Su Lang left the stronghold, he came to a corridor filled with colorful poisonous miasma.
At this point, Su Lang had already left the human base and officially walked alone in the Canglan Continent.
However, this place was too close to the stronghold, and Su Lang did not immediately summon the clone and the treasure hunt flying flying flying fly.
"Leave the tunnel first!"
Licking his lips, Su Lang followed the tunnel to the outside world, and then flew out of the valley with his flying sword.
At first glance, he saw a huge sun and a huge moon!
The sun and the moon exist at the same time, forming a rare spectacle!
Moreover, Su Lang could clearly feel that the sun and moon were essentially different from those of Blue Star.
They exude a very strong extraordinary power!
"What a strange fantasy world!"
Su Lang looked up at the sky and couldn't help but admire it.
But at this moment, his expression suddenly changed, and his powerful mental power made him feel a trace of danger and hostility.
And this feeling of danger happens to come from the valley filled with colorful poisonous miasma!
"It must be the existence of Wu Zun level that can make me feel dangerous."
"But, who did I offend in the branch stronghold, who would be hostile to me?"
Su Lang's eyes narrowed slightly, and after some thought, two candidates were determined.
"The ones who have enemies with me are nothing but Li Qiming and Jin Xiutian.
"The visitor is a Wu Zun. If it is Jin Xiutian, he can only instruct others."
"I showed such awesome combat power in Tatian stronghold, and was accepted as a disciple by Lu Bai and other seniors. Those martial arts should not know the general situation and come to kill me."
"In this way, it is more likely that Li Qiming will come. He is arrogant and self-sufficient, so it should be him!"
"Hmph, it's really narrow-minded, isn't it just to get closer to Xiao Ning? You dare to come and kill me, not knowing whether you live or die!"
A sneer gradually appeared on Su Lang's face as he flew away with his flying sword.
He knew that Li Qiming's reluctance to do anything must be because he was too close to the human base for fear of attracting the attention of the other human warriors.
When the matter of internal fighting is leaked out, no matter what, the most severe punishment will be ushered in!
Li Qiming didn't dare to take this risk!
Therefore, Su Lang deliberately flew far away and led Li Qiming to take action!
really!
After Su Lang flew out for dozens of kilometers, a black spot was quickly chasing after him.
The black spot grew bigger and bigger in the field of vision, and finally revealed a human figure covered in black mist.
"Hehe, so far away from the stronghold, you still hide your head and show your tail!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth and gradually slowed down and glide to the ground.
The speed of the people chasing after him did not decrease, and after a few breaths, they came to Su Lang's head.
Then, the black mist dissipated, revealing Li Qiming's hideous face.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: Li Qiming, you are awesome!
paragraphs: "Humph!"
"Su Lang small chop, today is your death date!"
Li Qiming looked down at Su Lang condescendingly, his eyes full of excitement about revenge.
"Li Qiming, it's really you!"
"I didn't expect that there would be someone as narrow-minded as you in the world."
Su Lang sneered again and again, "In my opinion, your heart is only the size of a needle eye."
"Humph!!"
"You, a native dog from the countryside, dare to walk so close to Xiao Ning. You don't know anything about it!"
"Besides, you are only a martial arts commander, what qualifications do you have to let Lu Bai and other seniors teach together?"
"I don't know how much time it will take to nurture your waste material, it is better to leave your position to me!"
Li Qiming stood high and aimed at Su Lang with his nostrils, his face was full of contempt.
"Ha ha!"
Su Lang sneered, "Are you not afraid that I will spread the news and make you be charged with murdering your fellow clan?"
"Hey, do you think I will be unprepared?"

Li Qiming showed mockery on his face, and took out an eight-sided formation, "I have activated this two-dimensional isolation formation long ago, and the formation has been covering you since you left the valley.
Let me tell you, not only is it a jade card for communication, but all other communication methods are useless. If you don't believe it, you can try it! "
As soon as these words came out, Su Lang was stunned: "Is it another two-way isolation formation? This formation has brought me a lot of convenience!
Last time in the Wolong Mountains, Owenyao used the two instruments to isolate the magic circle to prevent Su Lang and An Xin from spreading information.
At the same time, Ou Wenyao himself could not call for help, so he could only silently die at Su Lang's hands.
To this day, no one knows the news of Owen Yao's death!
And now, Li Qiming is about to repeat the mistakes of Owenyao!
Of course, at this time he thought he was going to eat Su Lang.
"Su Lang, I can give you a chance now!"
Li Qiming said faintly, "You will be in the palace right now, I can spare you a lot of fun!"
Because Su Lang and Xiao Ning were so close, they even passed the night.
Li Qiming felt green on his head when he thought of that night, so he wanted to cut off Su Lang's strong wind, and let out a sigh of relief.
"Li Qiming, are you sure you have a chance to win?"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows and smiled, "Let me tell you, it will be you who will die today. If you turn off the isolation formation of the two instruments, there is still a chance to ask for help!"
"Is it dead?"
"Let me turn off the two instruments to isolate the formation and ask for help. It is you who want to ask for help!"
"Your rusty brain can only come up with such crude little tricks."
"But, if you can grab the Liangyi isolation plate from my hands, why don't you ask for help!"
Li Qiming laughed loudly, then isolated the two instruments in his hand and threw it behind him, and fell to the ground with a bang.
"Tsk tusk, Li Qiming, you are awesome!"
Su Lang really didn't expect Li Qiming to be so arrogant, so he immediately threw away the two instruments.
"Hmph, of course you are better, what are you!"
Li Qiming showed contempt, slowly descending, floating in front of Su Lang, with his toes facing Su Lang's face.
"I said, you will be in the palace right now, and I will give you a good time."
Li Qiming glanced at Su Lang contemptuously, "I will only give you the opportunity once. If you don't grasp it, I will let you know what life is better than death!"
"It seems that you are determined to kill me."
Su Lang pouted noncommittal, "If that's the case, then come and see who is better than dead!"
"Humph!"
"Dare to be tough when you die!"
"Look at me making you taste the pain of the world!"
The arrogance and coldness on Li Qiming's face instantly turned into cruelty.
Immediately afterwards, he dashed down and grabbed, as if he wanted to grab Su Lang by the neck.
"A fool!"
Su Lang sneered, and the Youtian Sword with black stripes on a white background appeared in his hand, and suddenly slashed out!
"What kind of sword is this!!"
When Li Qiming saw Youtian Sword, he immediately smelled a hint of danger, and he didn't even want to immediately recruit and retreat!
His speed was so fast that he escaped the slash of the Youtian Sword in the short-term.
But even so, Li Qiming felt that a scar was imprinted in the sea of his spirit!
This sword can actually cut the soul!
